mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in UNRATE > 8.5% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand that accelerates revenue growth for S&P 500 constituents, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or joint RSAFS/HOUST increases do not yield positive 20-day returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates for equity valuation and reduces liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS > 0.5% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 1.5% indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in GDPC1 > 1.5% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 90 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in INDPRO < 90 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates labor market strength and consumer spending momentum that accelerates revenue growth for S&P 500 firms.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or joint PAYEMS/RSAFS growth does not produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) together indicate supply contraction that reduces corporate output capacity and profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or joint INDPRO/HOUST decline does not yield negative 60-day returns in > 60% of cases.
